On May 10, 2026 , the Eredivisie stage was set at the home of Fortuna Sittard for a highly anticipated clash against PEC Zwolle . Fans gathered in their thousands to witness a tactical battle between two sides eager to secure vital league points in a fixture that would eventually turn into a dramatic spectacle. Early Dominance from the Hosts Fortuna Sittard started the match with clear intent, dictating the tempo and testing the visitor's resolve early on. The breakthrough arrived in the 21st minute when Lance Duijvestijn unleashed a precise left-footed strike from outside the box, following a well-timed assist by Kaj Sierhuis . The momentum stayed firmly with the home side throughout the first half, and they were inches away from doubling their lead in the 44th minute when Neraysho Kasanwirjo saw his powerful effort crash against the post. Despite the missed opportunity, the hosts headed into the break with a deserved lead. VAR Drama and a Three-Goal Cushion The second half began with immediate action as Yassin Oukili found the back of the net in the 50th minute with a clinical left-footed finish. The goal was initially met with silence as a VAR review took place, but the referee eventually signaled that the goal stood, sending the home crowd into a frenzy. The pressure didn't stop there; in the 65th minute, Kaj Sierhuis turned from provider to scorer, meeting a cross with a brilliant right-footed volley to make it 3-0. At this stage, the result seemed beyond doubt as Fortuna Sittard appeared to be in complete control. Zwolle’s Late Resurgence Against the odds, PEC Zwolle mounted a spirited comeback in the final quarter of the match. The revival started in the 75th minute when Gabriel Reiziger produced an exquisite left-footed lob over the keeper after being set up by Jamiro Monteiro . As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the tension rose significantly. In the 93rd minute, Zico Buurmeester rose highest to head home a corner from Thijs Oosting , reducing the deficit to a single goal. Despite a frantic final few minutes and a yellow card for Rodney Kroeze during a desperate tactical foul, Fortuna Sittard managed to withstand the late onslaught from PEC Zwolle to claim all three points in front of an attendance of 10,117 .

A Tense Eredivisie Affair On May 17, 2026, the atmosphere was electric at the stadium as PEC Zwolle hosted Feyenoord for an intriguing Eredivisie clash. With an attendance of 14,000, both sides fought for supremacy in a match that demanded high concentration and tactical discipline from the very first whistle. Late Breakthrough For most of the first half and the majority of the second half , the game was a stalemate defined by persistent defensive blocks and a flurry of corners. Anis Hadj Moussa was a constant threat from the wings for Feyenoord , constantly whipping in crosses, yet the elusive goal remained out of reach as the defensive line of PEC Zwolle held firm. The deadlock was finally broken in the 79th minute when Gijs Smal provided the perfect assist for Anis Hadj Moussa , who coolly finished with his left foot to give the visitors a vital lead. As the game entered its closing stages, the intensity rose significantly. PEC Zwolle looked for a response, but it was Feyenoord that capitalized on their momentum. In the 87th minute, Luciano Valente set up Anis Hadj Moussa , who once again found the back of the net with his left foot to double his tally and secure the result. This tactical victory highlighted the importance of clinical finishing in high-level sports , as Feyenoord walked away with a hard-fought win.
